summary.text: Joshua Sanchez is a Republican who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2021, representing District 29 in Socorro and Valencia counties.
Sanchez is ranking member of the Senate Tax, Business and Transportation Committee and also sits on the Senate Indian, Rural and Cultural Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Sanchez's occupation as small business owner and a district office in Los Lunas.
Between sessions, Sanchez serves in an advisory role on the Economic and Rural Development and Policy Committee, the Indian Affairs Committee and the Land Grant Committee.
